description: This Python module provides functions for adding service-specific attributes to OpenTelemetry spans, including handling different AI services like TTS, STT, LLM, Gemini, and OpenAI, with utility functions for extracting system names and setting span attributes.

methods.name: _get_gen_ai_system_from_service_name
methods.description: Extracts standardized gen_ai.system value from a service class name, with special case mappings for known providers.

methods.name: add_tts_span_attributes
methods.description: Adds TTS-specific attributes to an OpenTelemetry span, including service name, model, voice ID, and optional metrics and settings.

methods.name: add_stt_span_attributes
methods.description: Adds STT-specific attributes to a span, such as transcript, language, user ID, and metrics.

methods.name: add_llm_span_attributes
methods.description: Adds LLM-specific attributes including messages, output, tools, and parameters, with system name extraction.

methods.name: add_gemini_live_span_attributes
methods.description: Adds Gemini Live session attributes like transcript, tools, modalities, and settings.

methods.name: add_openai_realtime_span_attributes
methods.description: Adds OpenAI Realtime session attributes including context, function calls, tools, and session properties.
